Tucked between the preserves of the Point Washington State Forest and the Watercolor Beach Resort lay 30A’s newest gem, NatureWalk. A 155-acre master-planned resort community built from the ground up to enhance your vacation experience and rejuvenate the soul. Surrounded by the area’s natural beauty, and teeming with nature and fitness trails, NatureWalk invoices a sense of sanctuary and tranquility in all of its guests. The community is within biking or walking distance of our famous white sand beaches and within steps of all the dining, shopping, and fitness options located at WaterColor Crossings (including a Publix). At the heart of NatureWalk lies The Gathering Place, a vacationers' wonderland, complete with two pools (one seasonally heated), a hot tub, fire pit, an entertainment bar, and of course, a children’s playground. Located near the beautiful white sand and adjacent to the famous coastal village of Seaside, NatureWalk perfectly encompasses the laid-back attitude and southern grace that make up the 30A lifestyle.


 



Across NatureWalk’s wooden welcoming bridge you will find our beautiful NatureWalk vacation rental home. This stunning home offers luxurious accommodations for up to 13 guests in 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms in a family-friendly resort community. Thoughtfully designed with premium appliances and warm wooden floors, this home is designed to provide a luxurious vacation experience with all the amenities that your family would expect from a world-class vacation!


 


In this carefully-curated vacation home you'll discover four covered porches that beckon you to unwind and savor the coastal breeze. The back porch, a screened sanctuary, provides a picturesque vista overlooking the tranquil expanse of Point Washington Forest - a breathtaking backdrop that merges seamlessly with your living space. The fully-appointed kitchen, with granite countertops, is perfect for the even the most discriminating home-chef.  After all, just because you're on vacation, doesn't mean that you can't have sit-down family meals!  Cook for the whole family, while enjoying the distinctive kitchen island with drop pendant lights and stainless steel appliances.


 


The two (2) Master Suites are located on the first (perfect for those who have problems with stairs) and second floors. The second floor Master Suite comes complete with a luxurious King bed, and has it's own stunning bathroom with dual vanity, soaking tub and walk-in shower! The first floor  Master Suite has a King bed and private bathroom with single vanity and shower/tub combo.


 


All bedrooms have access to covered balconies with seating and views of the Florida Sunset! The perfect place to have a morning coffee or an evening glass of wine!


 


Also upstairs, you'll also find another two (2) rooms. Both of these Guest Rooms hold a Queen bed and share a bathroom (with a shower/tub combo and double vanity) with the other.  Finally, there is a Bunk/Flex Area with a Twin-over-Full Bunk Bed and Pullout Queen Sleeper Sofa.  This is the perfect place for the kid's to hang out!


 


The huge, screened-in back patio-porch is the perfect space to wind down with your favorite beverage, relax while taking in the splendor of the adjacent Point Washington Forest, or grill out on the propane (provided) grill.  Upstairs, there is a covered, screened-in balcony with peaceful views of the adjacent pond!


With everything to love about this NatureWalk home, you won't be able to wait to come back next year!



30A is a scenic stretch of highway down Florida’s beautiful Gulf Coast between Destin and Panama City Beach. The highway connects the coastal villages of South Walton through the undisturbed beauty of rare dune lakes, sugar-white sand, and emerald blue waters indigenous to the area. Each village has its own unique characteristics that paint a fairytale-like scene against some of the country’s most beautiful beaches. Come live the 30A life and experience the beach the way it was meant to be, where Southern Charm meets Bohemian lifestyle and unforgettable vacation memories are created.


 


Enjoy our 4 Adult Beach Cruiser Bicycles to cruise down 30A in Style!
Quick bike rides to the beach, Seaside, Watercolor and more!!
(Included in Amenity Fees at Check-out)


This home is on our Resort Linen and Terry Package with guaranteed fresh linen and terry placed at every turn!
(Excludes Beach Towels)



 

Beach Access:


NatureWalk enjoys a private nature path to the beach. The Lilly Lane Beach Trail, located near The Gathering Place, travels through nature preserves to the San Juan Avenue beach access (about 1 mi). Scenic 395 Beach Access is also 1.9 mi. away.


Nearby Restaurants:
Nearby restaurants to NatureWalk 30A include Pizza by the Sea, Fish Out of Water, The Perfect Pig, Seagrove Village Market, Bud and Alley’s, The Great Southern Café, and many, many more!

Best regards,
BeachWalk Vacations

reviews.text:
This property was absolutely beautiful!!! Our family loved our stay for Thanksgiving week. The house is decorated beautifully and is well maintained and very clean. Loved having the use of the 6 seater golf cart
and the four bicycles! It was so fun to bike up to the pool and take the golf cart to dinner in Seaside every night! We will definitely be renting Maison De Paix again!:)

reviews.text: We so enjoyed our stay at Madison De Paix! Everything was perfect and we could not have asked for anything better. The house has plenty of room for everyone to have their own space. The back screened in porch is perfect for morning coffee, the front porch swing and the upstairs decks are all awesome. So many spaces to enjoy. The decor is beautiful and all the beds slept wonderfully. The neighborhood was so peaceful and with the included golf cart you could get anywhere you wanted to go easily and quickly. Our only complaint is that we can’t stay and just live in this house, we absolutely loved every minute of our stay.
